paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, huai lai in Philistia mite'n asepaihte uh Israel mite sual a dou ding in akaikhawm uh. Akish in David kiang ah, "Nang leh na mite kei toh galdou dia na hong kuan ngeingei ding uh ahi, chih thei in," achi hi.
David in Akish kiang ah, "Aw le, na sikha in bang ahihthei a chih na thei ding," achi hi. Akish in David kiang ah, "Ahoih ve, kei hon vengpa ding in ka hon bawl den ding," achi hi.
Samuel asita a, Israel mi tengteng in akah ua, amah khua mah Ramah ah avui uhi. Saul in dawi aisan siam zawlte leh dawisiamte agam a pan adelhkhe khin hi.
heading: Saul In Dawisiam Adong

paite: Philistia mite akikaikhawm ua, Shunem ah panmun akhoh uh. Saul in Israel mi tengteng akaikhawm a, Gilboa ah panmun akhoh sam hi.
Saul in Philistia sepaihte amuhtak in alau a, alungsim aling tonton maimah hi.
Saul in TOUPA adot in leng TOUPA'N mang hiam, Urim hiam, zawlnei hiam in leng adawng himhim kei hi.
Saul in asikhate kiang ah, "Dawi aisan siam zawl numei akiang a ka hoh a ka dot ding hon zonkhiaksak un," achi hi. Asikhate'n akiang ah, "Ngai in, Endor a dawi aisan siam numei om ei ve," achi uhi.
Saul akibawl lamdang a, puan dang asilh a, amah leh midang nih ahoh uh. Zan in numei kiang ava tung uhi. "Dawi aisanna in ai hon sansak inla, na kiang a, amin ka gen peuhmah hon sapsak in," achi hi.
Numei in akiang ah, "Ngai in, Saul thilhih na thei a, agam a dawi aisan siam leh dawisiamte ahihmang khinta a, bangziak a ka sihna dia ka hinna thang kamkhum dia kisa na hia?" achi hi.
Saul in, "TOUPA min lou in, TOUPA ahin bang in ka gen ahi. Hiai thil ziak in na tung ah gawtna atung kei ding," chi in akiang ah akichiam hi.
Numei in, "Kua ka hon sapkhiaksak dia?" achi hi. Ama'n, "Samuel hon sapkhiaksak in," achi hi.
Numei in Samuel amuhleh ngaihtak in akikou a, Saul kiang ah, "Bangziak a hon khem, Saul lah na hi ngal a?" achi hi.
Kumpipa'n akiang ah, "Lau ke'n. Bang a na muh?" achi hi. Numei in Saul kiang ah, "Lei a pan pathiante hong pawtkhia ka mu,” achi hi.
Akiang ah, "Bangchibang ahia?" achi hi. Ama'n, "Putekpi ahong pawt a, puanaktual asilh," achi hi. Saul in Samuel ahi chih athei a, amai a lei in akun hi.

Samuel in Saul kiang ah, "Bangziak a hihbuai a hon samkhia na hia?" achi hi. Saul in adawng a, "Ka lung azing mahmah a ahi. Philistia mite'n ahon dou ua, Pathian in lah ahon lehngatsan a, zawlnei hiam, mang hiam in leng lah ahon dawng himhim kei hi. Huaiziak in ka hih ding hon hilh ding in ka hon sam ahi," achi hi.
Samuel in, "Huchi a TOUPA hon lehngatsan in na melma ahong hita, chih theigige kawm a bangziak a thu hon dong?
Kei hon zang a, agen bang in TOUPA'N na tung a hih ahita ve. TOUPA'N na khut a pan gam ahon sut a, na invengpa David apeta hi.
TOUPA thu na man louh ziak leh Amalekte tung a aheh mahmah dungzui a na tangtun louh ziak in. Tu in na tung ah hiai thil ahihta hi.

Huai lou leng, TOUPA'N nang leh Israelte leng Philistia mite khut ah ahon pe dia; zingchiang in nang leh na tapate ka kiang ah na hong om ding uh. TOUPA'N Israel sepaihte leng Philistia mite khut ah ape ding," achi hi.
Huchi in Samuel thugen ziak in Saul alau mahmah a, lei ah apuk vialvual maimah hi. Tha leh zung himhim anei kei; nitum leh zankhua a an ne lou ahi ngal a.
Saul kiang ah numeinu ahoh a, adah mahmah chih athei hi. Akiang ah, "Ngai in, na sikhanu'n na gen ka taksang a, sih-le-sih ka kiang a na thugente ka zui hi.
Huaiziak in nang leng na sikhanu thu taksang sam in. An tawmchik bek ka hon lui dia, huchi in na pai chiang a hatna na neihtheihna ding in ne in," achi hi.
Himahleh a-ut kei a, "Ka ne kei ding,” achi hi. Himahleh asikhate'n numei toh asawl teitei ua; a thu uh amangta hi. Lei a pan athou a, lupna ah atuta hi.
Numei in a-inn ah bawngnou vak thau anei a, agou zok a; tangbuang ala a, amek a, silngou soh louh tanghou abawl hi.
Saul leh asikhate ma ah alui a, aneta uh. Huchi in athou ua, huai zan in apaita uhi.
